en: Black-and-white panoramic river scene showing a European town on a hill above a wide, calm river. In the foreground is a rocky, wooded riverbank; on the opposite bank stands an industrial building with a tall smokestack and other riverside structures. A narrow pedestrian or service bridge crosses the river toward a small floating bath-house or pavilion moored midstream. Up on the ridge are dense trees, then a line of 19th‑century townhouses, a large pointed neo‑Gothic church with a tall central spire, and, further right, a compact hilltop castle or fortified complex with towers and curtain walls. The view has the framing, aspect ratio, and wear typical of an early 20th‑century postcard or photographic card.
